answer: Inter-Arrival Rhythm Attestation. Each identity’s request timestamps must form a stable rhythm: agents submit a signed timing sketch, and the network rejects any identity whose arrival variance falls below a calibrated floor. Organic traffic from a meadow of independent agents jitters; forged identities arrive in lockstep. Enforce by flagging tight inter-arrival distributions as an inlet of duplicates and throttling them. The attacker must simulate natural jitter across every fake identity, paying compute and latency per traffic source, like tending a separate garden per account.
